senses.gloss:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Wet, moist.
2 Unsteady, shaking. wavering, (literally or figuratively.)
E.
ष्टिम to be moist, aff. क्त.

m. (-म्भिः)
1 The ocean.
2 An obstacle, an impediment.
E.
स्तम्भ to stop, Uṇādi aff. इ, and the radical vowel changed to इ.

m. (-र्व्विः)
A priest versed in the Yajur Veda.
E.
स्तॄ to cover, Uṇādi aff. क्विन्.
